recurring.name: CQ World Wide DX Contest (SSB)
recurring.where: Contest (SSB). Busy bands: lots of fast contacts for a park activation, so find a clear frequency first. If you work them, give: RS(T) + CQ zone 4. The WARC bands (30, 17, 12 m) never have contests.

recurring.name: ARRL November Sweepstakes (CW)
recurring.where: Contest (CW). Busy bands: lots of fast contacts for a park activation, so find a clear frequency first. If you work them, give: number, precedence (Q/A/B/U/M/S), your call, check (last 2 digits of the year you were first licensed), section (KY). The WARC bands (30, 17, 12 m) never have contests.
